model_annotation:
The line graph shows a comparison of results across three categories: lattice, FLAT, and OURS. 
The x-axis is labeled "epoch (次数)" with a linear scale, marked from 0 to 18 at intervals of 2, and represents the number of epochs. 
The y-axis is unlabeled but has a linear scale marked from 0.55 to 0.60 at intervals of 0.05. 
The graph includes three lines: a red line with square markers representing lattice, a blue line with circle markers representing FLAT, and a yellow line with triangle markers representing OURS. 
At the beginning of the graph, around 0 on the x-axis, the red line starts near 0.55 on the y-axis, the blue line and yellow line both start slightly above 0.55. 
As the x-axis increases to 18, all three lines show an upward trend. 
By the end of the graph, at 18 on the x-axis, the red line ends near 0.57 on the y-axis, the blue line ends slightly above 0.58, and the yellow line ends near 0.58.
